vo.text: The average 30-year-old has $5,400 in checking. You probably have less.
vo.bgPrompt: Cinematic close up of a glowing smartphone displaying a bank app in a dim room.

vo.text: Leaving over five grand in checking loses exactly $412 every year.
vo.bgPrompt: Dark macro shot of crisp dollar bills stacked neatly on a reflective glass table.

vo.text: Your bank pays 0.01% but lends your cash overnight at 5.3%.
vo.bgPrompt: Atmospheric shot of glass financial skyscrapers at night with illuminated windows.

vo.text: That spread goes straight into the bank's net interest margin.
vo.bgPrompt: High angle shot of a massive empty bank vault door glowing under moody light.

vo.text: Pause. Check your app right now. How much is sitting idle?
vo.bgPrompt: Sleek modern smartphone lying flat on a dark executive desk with glowing screen.

vo.text: Comment your idle cash balance below if you dare audit yourself.
vo.bgPrompt: Abstract dark blue grid with illuminated glowing digital particles floating slowly.

vo.text: Set a $1,000 checking floor and sweep the rest to high yield.
vo.bgPrompt: Fast kinetic chart lines surging upward against a dark moody trading screen.

vo.text: Treasury money market sweeps give you 5% with zero added risk.
vo.bgPrompt: Macro detail of a shiny gold coin resting on dark textured concrete.

vo.text: Banks set sweep defaults to 0.01% because lazy money funds dividends.
vo.bgPrompt: Dark corporate boardroom table with empty chairs overlooking a lit city skyline.

vo.text: And that is why idle balances forfeit exactly $412 every year.
vo.bgPrompt: Cinematic close up of a glowing smartphone displaying a bank app in a dim room.
